settings.name: bias0
settings.imu_bias_model: policy-side constant vector added to the raw base_ang_vel (rad/s) and projected_gravity (unit-vector components) observation columns (no scale/history on these terms), before the IMU delay and zero_terms; |vector| = the given magnitude exactly, direction uniform on the sphere from a CPU torch.Generator(seed + 11), gyro and gravity drawn independently; constant per env for the setting's whole rollout (each setting starts at env.reset, so constant over the scored first episode); same seed -> same directions at every magnitude and for every policy
